data: Apple spent more on research and development in fiscal 2025. Its R&D expense was about $34.6 billion for the year ended September 27, 2025, up from roughly $31.4 billion in fiscal 2024. Microsoft's R&D expense was about $32.5 billion for the year ended June 30, 2025, up from $29.5 billion in fiscal 2024. Apple's figure is about 1.06 times Microsoft's, or roughly $2.1 billion (about 6%) higher. The fiscal years end at different times, so the periods are not perfectly aligned. These figures come from my recollection of the companies' 10-K filings, not from a document I checked here, so confirm them against the filings before relying on them.
